description_en: Calls AMB to rewrite text in a new tone
kebab_example: aliyun aimiaobi run-write-tone-generation --workspace-id llm-xxx --reference-data '{"Contents":["xxx"]}' --task-id 7AA2AE16-D873-5C5F-9708-15396C382EB1 --prompt '励志' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunWriteToneGeneration

parameters.help_en: Unique identifier of your Alibaba Cloud Model Studio workspace. To get this ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2782167.html
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云百炼业务空间唯一标识：获取https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2782167.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en:
Unique identifier of the associated article.

You do not need to specify TaskId. The system generates it automatically. If you use the same TaskId in later requests, those requests belong to the same conversation group
parameters.help_zh:
关联创作文章唯一标识
TaskId默认无需填写，系统将自动生成。当后续任务填写的TaskId相同时，表示这些任务属于同一组对话
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: Tone. Examples include lyrical, bold, subtle, excited, friendly, and inspirational
parameters.help_zh: 文风：比如"抒情", "豪放", "含蓄", "激动", "亲切", "励志"
parameters.name: prompt
